newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, investors picky.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, investors picky.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Wednesday in modest trade as investors focused on a handful of selected issues.
* Six of 13 stocks rose, five fell and two ended flat.
* Volume was slightly lower at 8,461 units, with turnover rising to 7.7 from 4.8 milion kuna.
* Biggest gainer Karlovacka Pivovara brewery added 20 kuna or 3.51 percent to 590 kuna on volume of 301 shares.
* Biggest decliner Varazdinska Banka first issue lost 10 kuna or 4.54 percent to 210 kuna with 520 shares sold.
* Hotelier Laguna, selling 1,726 units, was the most active and rose eight kuna or 0.53 percent to 1,509 kuna.
* Fully-listed Zagrebacka Banka rose 40 kuna or 2.08 percent to 1,960 kuna with 1,318 ordinary shares sold, making it the second most actively traded issue.
